summary: Inspected repo structure, session context (Team: Yes we did hack it, Track: 2), and skill requirements; identified implementation state across backend, frontend, extension.

Updated validateCollaborationInput.js, Team.js memberSchema, and collaborationController.js to support low-friction member invites with optional name defaulting to empty string and required email and role.
Implemented invitation email sending endpoint POST /api/collaborations/:teamId/invitations/send with Resend SDK, sentAt schema field, idempotency, failure handling, and test suite.
